How TrendRadar works, in one post:

We pull live signals: search interest, marketplace bestsellers, festival-calendar timing. Then we score each product or category on how fast it's moving right now rather than how big it already is.

This week's top mover (saree) was flagged before most people would think to look. That's the whole bet: catch it early, show our work, and never claim more than the data supports.

No guesswork. No hype. The receipts do the talking.
